text.p: German media groups Bertelsmann AG, scientific publisher Springer-Verlag GmbH and Burda Holdings GmbH & Co. KG said on Monday they have joined to develop two online medical information services.
A professional online service for doctors would combine Burda's year-old Health Online Service with the Multimedica service that was jointly launched by Bertelsmann and Springer.
Bertelsmann and Springer would each have a 37.5 percent share of the new service, the companies said in a statement. Burda New Media GmbH would own 25 percent.

A second service providing medical information for the public would be based on Lifeline, a service that originated as a 50-50 venture of Bertelsmann and Springer. Under the new arrangement, Burda would take over Springer's share of Lifeline.
"We are getting closer to critical mass with this and in the future the srevice will be offered on a single platform," said Bernd Schiphorst, president of Bertelsmann New Media.
